name: B2 — Upper Intermediate
description: Discuss abstract topics, defend opinions, and handle the news, the workplace, and contemporary Chinese culture.

topics.title: Expressing opinions
topics.description: Hedge, agree, push back, and stack reasons

guide.intro: At B2 you stop just stating opinions and start structuring them — adding nuance, layering reasons, and naming the side you fall on. Three patterns will carry most of your opinion-talk for the rest of your Chinese life: 不仅…而且 (not only…but also), 我觉得…比较 (I think…relatively), and 一方面…另一方面 (on one hand…on the other).

sections.text: 不僅…而且 — not only…but also

不僅 (bù jǐn) sets up the first half of a two-part claim, and 而且 (ér qiě) adds the second, usually stronger, point. The two halves can share a subject (which sits in front) or have different subjects (which sit after each particle).

rows.source: 他不僅會說中文，而且會說日語。
rows.pinyin: Tā bù jǐn huì shuō Zhōngwén, ér qiě huì shuō Rìyǔ.
rows.translation: He not only speaks Chinese, but also Japanese.

rows.source: 這家餐廳不僅便宜，而且很好吃。
rows.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bù jǐn piányi, ér qiě hěn hǎo chī.
rows.translation: This restaurant is not only cheap but also delicious.

rows.source: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他。
rows.pinyin: Bù jǐn wǒ xǐhuan tā, ér qiě wǒ mèimei yě xǐhuan tā.
rows.translation: Not only do I like him, but my sister does too.

sections.text: Common mistake: dropping 而且 and joining with a comma. In Mandarin, 不僅 always pairs with 而且 (or 也 / 還). "他不僅高，帥" sounds incomplete.
Softening: 我覺得 + 比較

比較 (bǐ jiào) means "relatively" or "fairly" — it takes the edge off an opinion the way "kind of" does in English. Pair it with 我覺得 (wǒ jué de, "I feel") for a polite, hedged tone that won't sound confrontational.

rows.source: 我覺得這個想法比較有意思。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè ge xiǎngfǎ bǐ jiào yǒu yì si.
rows.translation: I think this idea is fairly interesting.

rows.source: 我覺得他說的比較有道理。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jué de tā shuō de bǐ jiào yǒu dào lǐ.
rows.translation: I think what he said makes a fair amount of sense.

sections.text: Two sides: 一方面…另一方面
Use 一方面 (yī fāng miàn)…另一方面 (lìng yī fāng miàn) to lay out two sides of the same issue — the closest Mandarin gets to "on one hand…on the other hand".

rows.source: 一方面工作很累，另一方面工資也不高。
rows.pinyin: Yī fāng miàn gōng zuò hěn lèi, lìng yī fāng miàn gōng zī yě bù gāo.
rows.translation: On one hand the work is tiring, on the other hand the pay isn't great either.

items: 我同意你的看法 — I agree with your view
我不太同意 — I don't quite agree
我有不同的看法 — I have a different view

lessons.title: I think, I feel
lessons.description: Stating a view with 覺得 and 認為

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between 覺得 and 認為?
options: 覺得 is more casual/feeling-based; 認為 is more considered/formal
覺得 means "think"; 認為 means "feel"
exercises.answer: 覺得 is more casual/feeling-based; 認為 is more considered/formal

exercises.prompt: Build "I think this movie is really worth watching"
exercises.answer: 我 覺得 這部 電影 很 值得 看

exercises.prompt: "我認為他說得有道理" means ___
exercises.answer: I think what he said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I believe what he said makes sense
I think he has a point

exercises.prompt: Which is the most natural way to soften "I think it's expensive"?
exercises.answer: 我覺得有點兒貴
exercises.explanation: 有點兒 (yǒu diǎnr) before an adjective is what does the softening — without it, 我覺得貴 is grammatical but blunt.

exercises.prompt: Build a more formal opinion: "I personally believe this idea is worth considering"
exercises.answer: 我 個人 認為 這個 想法 值得 考慮
exercises.explanation: 我個人認為 (wǒ gè rén rèn wéi) lifts the register — 個人 ("personally") plus 認為 sounds essay-like; 我覺得 would be the casual swap.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks 你覺得這家餐廳怎麼樣? Which reply HEDGES the most?
exercises.answer: 還行吧，菜比較一般
exercises.explanation: 還行吧 ("it's okay, I guess") plus 比較一般 ("relatively average") is the classic Chinese hedge — neither praising nor trashing.

exercises.prompt: "在我看來，這件事沒那麼簡單" means ___
exercises.answer: In my view, this matter isn't that simple
acceptableAnswers: From my perspective, it's not that simple
The way I see it, this isn't so simple
In my opinion, this isn't that simple
exercises.explanation: 在我看來 (zài wǒ kàn lái) — "in my view". A common B2 opener for stating an opinion with a touch more weight than 我覺得.

exercises.prompt: the opinion-opener to its register

pairs.right: Stating a view: in my view
Older / literary: as I see it

exercises.prompt: Build "I think this question deserves more thought"
exercises.answer: 我 覺得 這個 問題 值得 多 想 一下

exercises.prompt: Pick the BLUNT version (avoid in polite settings):
options: 我覺得他說得有點兒不對
exercises.answer: 他說的不對
exercises.explanation: Bare 不對 with no hedge is direct to the point of rude. The other three all soften with 覺得, 不太, or 可能.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "我覺得對" into a more formal/considered opinion. The blank should fill in: "我 ___ 這個觀點是正確的"
exercises.answer: 認為
exercises.explanation: Swap 覺得 → 認為 to lift register. 我認為這個觀點是正確的 — "I believe this view is correct".

exercises.prompt: Tap the opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 在 我 看 來
options: 在 我 看 來
在 我 來 看
看 來 我 在
我 看 在 來
exercises.answer: 在 我 看 來
exercises.explanation: 在我看來 (zài wǒ kàn lái) is a fixed four-syllable opener — the order is locked.

lessons.title: Not only, but also
lessons.description: Stack reasons with 不僅…而且

exercises.prompt: Build "This restaurant is not only cheap but also delicious"
exercises.answer: 這家 餐廳 不僅 便宜 而且 很 好吃

exercises.prompt: Pick the best translation for "Not only do I like him, my sister also likes him":
options: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他
exercises.answer: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他

exercises.prompt: "他不僅聰明，而且很努力" means ___
exercises.answer: He is not only smart but also hardworking
acceptableAnswers: Not only is he smart, he is also hardworking
He's not only clever but also diligent

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 他不僅高，帥
exercises.explanation: 不僅 must pair with 而且 / 還 / 也. A bare comma is not enough — the second clause needs a connector.

exercises.prompt: 不僅 cannot pair with which of these?
exercises.answer: 但是
exercises.explanation: 但是 introduces contrast ("but"). 不僅 needs an additive partner: 而且, 還, or 也.

exercises.prompt: Convert single-clause to compound: "He's hardworking and talented" → use 不僅...而且
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 努力 而且 有 才華

exercises.prompt: "這部電影不僅好看，___ 很有意義"
exercises.answer: 而且
exercises.explanation: Any of 而且 / 還 / 也 completes the 不僅 pattern. The most common written choice is 而且.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phone is not only expensive but also doesn't have a good battery"
exercises.answer: 這 部 手機 不僅 貴 而且 電池 也 不 好

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Not only does she sing, she also dances":
options: 她不僅會唱歌，還會跳舞
exercises.answer: 她不僅會唱歌，還會跳舞

exercises.prompt: "內卷不僅影響年輕人，還影響整個社會" means ___
exercises.answer: Involution doesn't only affect young people, it also affects the whole society
acceptableAnswers: Involution affects not only young people but the whole society
Not only does involution affect young people, it affects all of society
exercises.explanation: 內卷 — the cutthroat competition meme. The 不僅...還 frame stacks two scopes of impact.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector you hear
exercises.answer: 不 僅
exercises.explanation: 不僅 (bù jǐn) and 不但 (bù dàn) are near-synonyms — 不但 is slightly more spoken. 不過 means "however" and 不然 means "otherwise". Listen for the second syllable.

lessons.title: Agree & disagree
lessons.description: 同意, 反對, and the polite middle

exercises.prompt: the phrase to its meaning
Which is the most polite way to disagree?
exercises.answer: 我有不同的看法
exercises.explanation: Literally "I have a different view" — softer than a direct "you're wrong".

exercises.prompt: Build "I basically agree with your point of view"
exercises.answer: 我 基本 同意 你 的 看法

exercises.prompt: the agreement to its strength

pairs.right: Soft: I feel that way too

exercises.prompt: the disagreement to its tone

pairs.right: Pushback: I wouldn't put it that way

exercises.prompt: Build a hedged disagreement: "I'm not entirely sure I agree with this view"
exercises.answer: 我 不 太 確定 我 同意 這 個 看法

exercises.prompt: Your boss states a view in a meeting. Which response is appropriate?
options: 您的看法很有道理，不過我有一點不同意見
exercises.answer: 您的看法很有道理，不過我有一點不同意見
exercises.explanation: Concede first (有道理), then introduce disagreement with 不過 ("however") and a softener like 一點 — the standard formula for pushback in formal settings.

exercises.prompt: "話是這麼說，可是…" means ___
exercises.answer: That's true, but…
exercises.explanation: 話是這麼說，可是… is the most common spoken way to concede a point and pivot to your real objection.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest agreement:
exercises.answer: 完全同意

exercises.prompt: Build a hedge: "To some extent, I agree with you"
exercises.answer: 在 某 種 程度 上 我 同意 你
exercises.explanation: 在某種程度上 — "to a certain degree" — the classic essay hedge before partial agreement.

exercises.prompt: Tap the phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我 不 太 同意
options: 我 不 太 同意
exercises.answer: 我 不 太 同意
exercises.explanation: 不太 + verb is the soft-disagreement frame. Hear it as a polite "not quite" rather than "not at all".

lessons.title: Two sides of an issue
lessons.description: 一方面…另一方面 and 既…又

exercises.prompt: What does "一方面…另一方面" mean?
options: On one hand… on the other hand
exercises.answer: On one hand… on the other hand

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand the work is tiring, on the other hand the pay isn't high"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工作 很 累 另一方面 工資 也 不 高

exercises.prompt: "她既聰明又漂亮" means ___
exercises.answer: She is both smart and beautiful
acceptableAnswers: She is smart as well as beautiful
exercises.explanation: 既…又 (jì…yòu) stacks two qualities of the same subject — "both…and".

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "It's expensive but worth it"?
exercises.answer: 貴但是值得

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand the salary is high, on the other hand the pressure is also great"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工資 很 高 另一方面 壓力 也 很 大

exercises.prompt: "這個工作既穩定又有意思" means ___
exercises.answer: This job is both stable and interesting
acceptableAnswers: This job is stable and also interesting
It's a job that is both steady and interesting
exercises.explanation: 既...又 — stacks two qualities of one subject. 既 X 又 Y means "both X and Y".

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 她既漂亮也聰明
exercises.explanation: 既 pairs with 又 (not 也). 既 X 又 Y is the locked frame.

exercises.prompt: Build "Studying abroad has both advantages and disadvantages"
exercises.answer: 出國 留學 既 有 好處 又 有 壞處

exercises.prompt: the two-sided pattern

pairs.right: On one hand…on the other (separate clauses)

exercises.prompt: "凡事都有兩面" (fán shì dōu yǒu liǎng miàn) means ___
exercises.answer: Everything has two sides
acceptableAnswers: There are two sides to everything
exercises.explanation: A common B2 set phrase to open a balanced opinion. 凡事 = every matter.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although AI is convenient, it also brings problems"
exercises.answer: 雖然 人工智慧 很 方便 但是 也 帶 來 一些 問題

exercises.prompt: Pick the most balanced essay-style opening:
options: 凡事都有兩面：一方面…另一方面…
exercises.answer: 凡事都有兩面：一方面…另一方面…
exercises.explanation: Balanced essays in Chinese almost always open with 凡事都有兩面 or a similar two-sides formula before laying out 一方面 / 另一方面.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Discussing a film at a coffee shop
lessons.description: Hedge your film opinions, half-agree, and recommend with a caveat

exercises.prompt: Coffee-shop chat about a film you saw last night

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 你昨天看的那部電影怎麼樣？(Nǐ zuótiān kàn de nà bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?)
turns.spokenText: 你昨天看的那部電影怎麼樣？

turns.speaker: you
options: 我覺得劇情比較拖沓，不過演技不錯。(Wǒ juéde jùqíng bǐjiào tuōtà, búguò yǎnjì búcuò.)
劇情絕對爛透了，沒什麼好說的。(Jùqíng juéduì làn tòule, méi shénme hǎo shuō de.)
電影雖然好，因此結尾差。(Diànyǐng suīrán hǎo, yīncǐ jiéwěi chà.)
turns.answer: 我覺得劇情比較拖沓，不過演技不錯。(Wǒ juéde jùqíng bǐjiào tuōtà, búguò yǎnjì búcuò.)

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 對，我也覺得節奏有點慢。(Duì, wǒ yě juéde jiézòu yǒudiǎn màn.)
turns.spokenText: 對，我也覺得節奏有點慢。

turns.speaker: you
options: 我部分同意，不過那些慢鏡頭反而很有味道。(Wǒ bùfèn tóngyì, búguò nàxiē màn jìngtóu fǎn'ér hěn yǒu wèidào.)
完全同意而且非常好。(Wánquán tóngyì érqiě fēicháng hǎo.)
不知道我無所謂的吧。(Bù zhīdào wǒ wúsuǒwèi de ba.)
turns.answer: 我部分同意，不過那些慢鏡頭反而很有味道。(Wǒ bùfèn tóngyì, búguò nàxiē màn jìngtóu fǎn'ér hěn yǒu wèidào.)

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 說得也是。導演想表達的主題你看懂了嗎？(Shuō de yěshì. Dǎoyǎn xiǎng biǎodá de zhǔtí nǐ kàndǒng le ma?)
turns.spokenText: 說得也是。導演想表達的主題你看懂了嗎？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the hedge — 'I feel maybe'.
turns.after: 是在講家庭的疏離感。(Wǒ ___ shì zài jiǎng jiātíng de shūlí gǎn.)
turns.answer: 覺得大概

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 嗯，那種感覺確實貫穿全片。(Èn, nà zhǒng gǎnjué quèshí guànchuān quánpiàn.)
turns.spokenText: 嗯，那種感覺確實貫穿全片。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Recommend it — but with a caveat.
options: 推薦看，不過得有耐心，節奏比較慢。(Tuījiàn kàn, búguò děi yǒu nàixīn, jiézòu bǐjiào màn.)
強烈不推薦，肯定別看了。(Qiángliè bù tuījiàn, kěndìng bié kàn le.)
可以看也可以不看反正都行。(Kěyǐ kàn yě kěyǐ bù kàn fǎnzhèng dōu xíng.)
turns.answer: 推薦看，不過得有耐心，節奏比較慢。(Tuījiàn kàn, búguò děi yǒu nàixīn, jiézòu bǐjiào màn.)

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 好，我下週找時間去看。(Hǎo, wǒ xià zhōu zhǎo shíjiān qù kàn.)
turns.spokenText: 好，我下週找時間去看。

topics.title: News & current events
topics.description: Read a headline, summarize what happened, give your take

lessons.title: News vocabulary
lessons.description: 新聞, 報道, 媒體 — the building blocks

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
What does "頭條新聞" (tóu tiáo xīn wén) mean?
exercises.answer: Headline news
exercises.explanation: 頭條 literally means "top entry" — but it's also the name of a hugely popular news app, 今日頭條.

exercises.prompt: "據報道" (jù bào dào) means ___
exercises.answer: According to reports

exercises.prompt: the news-vocabulary term
What does "自媒體" (zì méi tǐ) mean?
exercises.answer: Self-published online media / influencer-style media
exercises.explanation: 自媒體 — literally "self-media". The Weibo / WeChat public accounts ecosystem; contrasted with 傳統媒體 (traditional media).

exercises.prompt: online vs traditional media term
Build "This piece of news got onto the trending list (熱搜)"
exercises.answer: 這 條 新聞 上 了 熱搜

exercises.prompt: "獨家報道" (dú jiā bào dào) means ___
exercises.answer: Exclusive report / exclusive coverage

exercises.prompt: What does "假新聞" (jiǎ xīn wén) mean?
exercises.answer: Fake news

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's headline news is about education reform"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 頭條 新聞 是 關於 教育 改革

exercises.prompt: Tap the news vocab you hear
exercises.spokenText: 突 發 新 聞
options: 突 發 新 聞
頭 條 新 聞
突 然 新 聞
熱 門 新 聞
exercises.answer: 突 發 新 聞
exercises.explanation: 突發 (tū fā) — "suddenly occurring" — pairs with 新聞 to form the breaking-news idiom. Don't confuse with 頭條 (headline) or 突然 (suddenly).

exercises.prompt: Which is the most NEWS-REGISTER way to start a sentence?
options: 我朋友說今天那個事兒…
exercises.answer: 據相關媒體報道，
exercises.explanation: 據相關媒體報道 — "according to relevant media reports" — the standard news opener. The casual options would never appear in a print or anchor segment.

lessons.title: What happened?
lessons.description: 發生, 引起, 影響 — narrating events

exercises.prompt: What does "發生" (fā shēng) mean?
exercises.answer: To happen / occur

exercises.prompt: Build "This event has had a big impact on society"
exercises.answer: 這件 事 對 社會 有 很大 的 影響

exercises.prompt: "引起廣泛關注" (yǐn qǐ guǎng fàn guān zhù) means ___
exercises.answer: Drew widespread attention

exercises.prompt: What does "事故" (shì gù) mean?
exercises.answer: Incident / accident

exercises.prompt: the verb to its meaning
Convert active to passive: "The accident was caused by drunk driving" using 被
exercises.answer: 這 起 事故 是 由 酒駕 造成 的
exercises.explanation: News register prefers 是…由…造成的 over plain 被. 由 marks the agent. 起 is the measure word for incidents.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This decision will have far-reaching effects":
options: 這個決定會產生深遠的影響
exercises.answer: 這個決定會產生深遠的影響
exercises.explanation: 產生影響 — "produce an impact" — is the standard collocation. 深遠 ("far-reaching") is essay-register.

exercises.prompt: "事件 (shì jiàn) 引發了 公眾 的 關注" means ___
exercises.answer: The incident sparked public attention
acceptableAnswers: The incident set off public attention
exercises.explanation: 引發 = trigger / set off — slightly stronger and more news-y than 引起.

exercises.prompt: Build "The incident drew widespread attention from society"
exercises.answer: 這 件 事 引起 了 社會 的 廣泛 關注

exercises.prompt: Pick the news-headline-style passive: "The suspect was arrested":
exercises.answer: 嫌疑人被警方逮捕
exercises.explanation: Headlines use formal verbs: 逮捕 (arrest) over casual 抓. 警方 over casual 警察.

exercises.prompt: "目前已造成多人受傷" (mù qián yǐ zào chéng duō rén shòu shāng) means ___
exercises.answer: So far it has caused multiple injuries
acceptableAnswers: As of now, multiple people have been injured
Currently it has caused several people to be injured
exercises.explanation: 目前 (currently) is the news-register version of 現在. 已 (already) is its 已經 equivalent. Strip the casualness for an anchor's voice.

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb you hear
exercises.answer: 導 致
exercises.explanation: 導致 (dǎo zhì) is more clinical and explanatory; 引起 (yǐn qǐ) is more general; 造成 (zào chéng) emphasizes negative outcomes. All three appear in news but the verb you hear here is 導致.

lessons.title: Politics & society
lessons.description: 政府, 政策, 社會 — the public sphere

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "The government has launched a new policy"
exercises.answer: 政府 出 臺 了 一 項 新 政策

exercises.prompt: "經濟發展" (jīng jì fā zhǎn) means ___
exercises.answer: Economic development

exercises.prompt: the public-sphere term
What does "出臺" (chū tái) mean in the context of policy?
exercises.answer: Roll out / introduce (a policy)
exercises.explanation: 出臺 here is news-register for "launch". 政府出臺新政策 = the government rolls out a new policy.

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy aims to support young people in starting businesses"
exercises.answer: 這 項 政策 旨在 支援 年輕 人 創業

guide.intro: 越…越 (yuè…yuè) is one of the most useful patterns at B2 — and one of the prettiest. It means "the more X, the more Y". You'll hear it everywhere from weather reports to op-eds. This topic uses environmental issues as the playground for it.

sections.text: 越…越 — the more…the more
The pattern is fixed: 越 + verb/adjective, 越 + verb/adjective. The two halves can share a subject (which sits at the front) or have different subjects.

rows.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè.
rows.translation: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

rows.pinyin: Tā yuè shuō yuè shēng qì.
rows.translation: The more he talked, the angrier he got.

rows.pinyin: Yǔ yuè xià yuè dà.
rows.translation: The rain came down heavier and heavier.

sections.text: 越來越 — getting X-er
越來越 (yuè lái yuè) is the most common form: "more and more". It always sits in front of an adjective or stative verb, and signals a trend over time.

rows.pinyin: Kōng qì yuè lái yuè chà.
rows.translation: The air is getting worse and worse.

rows.pinyin: Huán bǎo yuè lái yuè zhòng yào.
rows.translation: Environmental protection is getting more and more important.

sections.text: Don't add 很 between 越來越 and the adjective. "越來越很熱" is wrong — 越來越 already does the intensifying.
Two-subject form
When the two halves have different subjects, both subjects appear inside the pattern, after each 越:

rows.source: 天氣越冷，我越想吃火鍋。
rows.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lěng, wǒ yuè xiǎng chī huǒ guō.
rows.translation: The colder the weather, the more I want hotpot.

exercises.answer: Global warming

exercises.prompt: the sustainability buzzword
What does "碳中和" (tàn zhōng hé) mean?
exercises.answer: Carbon neutral
exercises.explanation: 碳中和 is the official Chinese term for the carbon-neutrality policy goal. Heard constantly in policy news.

exercises.prompt: Build "Air pollution has gotten worse and worse"
exercises.answer: 空氣 汙染 越 來 越 嚴重

exercises.prompt: "霧霾" (wù mái) means ___
exercises.answer: Smog

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Plastic pollution is a serious global issue":

exercises.answer: 塑膠汙染是一個嚴重的全球問題

exercises.prompt: Build "We should develop new energy and reduce carbon emissions"
exercises.answer: 我們 應該 發展 新能源 減少 碳 排放

exercises.prompt: "保護環境，人人有責" means ___
exercises.answer: Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility
acceptableAnswers: Everyone has a duty to protect the environment
exercises.explanation: 人人有責 (rén rén yǒu zé) — "everyone has responsibility" — a classic civic-slogan phrasing.

exercises.prompt: Tap the term you hear
exercises.answer: 碳 排 放
exercises.explanation: 碳 (tàn, carbon) is 4th-tone. Don't confuse with 彈 (tán, elastic / bullet) which is 2nd-tone.

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal/written register for "environmental protection":
exercises.answer: 環境保護
exercises.explanation: 環境保護 is the full formal noun. 環保 is the casual/spoken contraction. 保護環境 is the verb-object form.

lessons.title: The more, the more
lessons.description: Use 越…越 to describe trends

exercises.prompt: What does "天氣越來越熱" mean?
options: The weather is getting hotter and hotter
exercises.answer: The weather is getting hotter and hotter

exercises.prompt: Build "The air is getting worse and worse"
exercises.answer: 空氣 越 來 越 差

exercises.prompt: Build "The more he talked, the angrier he got"
exercises.answer: 他 越 說 越 生氣 了

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 天氣越來越很冷
exercises.explanation: 越來越 already intensifies — adding 很 is double-marking.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 他越來越非常努力
exercises.explanation: Same rule: 越來越 cannot be paired with another intensifier like 非常 or 很. Drop the 非常 — 他越來越努力 is correct.

exercises.prompt: Build "The colder the weather, the more I want to drink hot tea" (two-subject 越...越)

exercises.prompt: Build "The more I know about the environment, the more worried I get"

exercises.prompt: Tap the sentence you hear
exercises.spokenText: 天 氣 越 來 越 熱

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "We should ride bikes more and drive cars less"?
options: 我們應該多騎腳踏車，少開車
exercises.answer: 我們應該多騎腳踏車，少開車
exercises.explanation: 多 + verb / 少 + verb is a clean way to recommend more/less of an action.

exercises.prompt: "節約用水" (jié yuē yòng shuǐ) means ___
exercises.answer: Save / conserve water

exercises.prompt: Tap the sentence you hear
options: 今天 比 昨天 冷
今天 不 太 冷
exercises.answer: 今天 比較 冷
exercises.explanation: 比較 (bǐ jiào, "relatively") and 比 (bǐ, "compared to") sound nearly identical — but 比 always needs a comparison object after it (比 X), while 比較 just modifies an adjective.

exercises.prompt: Build "Today is five degrees hotter than yesterday" (比 + numerical comparison)

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "He is five centimeters taller than me":
exercises.answer: 他比我高五釐米
exercises.explanation: Pattern: A 比 B + adjective + number/amount. The amount of difference always comes after the adjective.

topics.title: Tech & daily life
topics.description: Apps, social media, 996 work culture, AI

lessons.title: Smartphone life
lessons.description: 微信, 支付寶, 二維碼 — China runs on apps

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "Please scan my WeChat QR code"
exercises.answer: 請 掃 一 下 我 的 微信 二維碼

exercises.prompt: "我手機沒電了" means ___
exercises.answer: My phone is out of battery
exercises.explanation: 沒電了 literally "has no electricity anymore" — used for any battery-powered thing.

exercises.prompt: the smartphone-life term
What does "Wifi 訊號不好" mean?
exercises.answer: Wifi signal is bad

exercises.prompt: Build "My phone is almost out of battery, can I charge it?"
exercises.answer: 我 的 手機 快 沒 電 了 可以 充 電 嗎

exercises.prompt: "加我微信" (jiā wǒ wēi xìn) means ___
exercises.answer: Add me on WeChat

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "My WeChat won't open":
exercises.answer: 我的微信打不開
exercises.explanation: 打不開 — potential complement: "can't open it (no matter how hard you try)". Standard tech complaint.

exercises.prompt: Build "You can pay by scanning the QR code" (用 X 來 Y instrument pattern)
exercises.answer: 你 可以 用 掃碼 來 付 錢

exercises.prompt: the app to its function
"流量不夠用" (liú liàng bù gòu yòng) means ___
exercises.answer: I don't have enough mobile data
exercises.explanation: 流量 = mobile data (literally "flow / quantity"). 不夠用 = not enough to use.

exercises.prompt: Tap the term you hear
exercises.answer: 二 維 碼
exercises.explanation: 二維碼 (èr wéi mǎ) — QR code, literally "two-dimensional code". You'll hear it dozens of times a day in China.

lessons.title: Social media & 朋友圈
lessons.description: Posting, liking, and the influencer ecosystem

exercises.prompt: What is "朋友圈" (péng you quān)?
options: A circle of friends in person
exercises.answer: WeChat's Moments / friends feed

exercises.prompt: the action
Build "I posted a photo on Moments"
exercises.answer: 我 在 朋友圈 發 了 一 張 照片

exercises.prompt: "刷影片" (shuā shì pín) means ___
exercises.answer: Scroll / swipe through videos
exercises.explanation: 刷 (shuā) literally means "brush" but for screens it's the verb for endless scrolling — Douyin, Xiaohongshu, etc.

exercises.prompt: Build "I deleted that post from my Moments"
exercises.answer: 我 把 那 條 朋友圈 刪 了
exercises.explanation: Posts on 朋友圈 take measure word 條 — same as for messages and news. 把 + obj + 刪了 is the canonical "deleted it" frame.

exercises.prompt: What does "遮蔽" (píng bì) mean in social media?
exercises.answer: Mute / hide someone's posts (without unfriending)
exercises.explanation: 遮蔽 — soft-block. The friend stays in your list but you don't see their posts. Crucial WeChat etiquette vocab.

exercises.prompt: "網路詐騙" (wǎng luò zhà piàn) means ___
exercises.answer: Online scam / internet fraud
exercises.explanation: Online safety vocab: 詐騙 = fraud, 騙子 = scammer, 釣魚網站 = phishing site.

exercises.prompt: the online-safety term
A friend WeChats you 我手機丟了，借我兩千. The most likely thing happening is:
options: It might be a 盜號 — their account was hijacked
exercises.answer: It might be a 盜號 — their account was hijacked
exercises.explanation: Classic 盜號 scam pattern. Always call before transferring money — 一定要打電話確認.

exercises.prompt: Build "Don't click on links from unfamiliar people"
exercises.answer: 不要 點 陌生 人 發 來 的 連結

exercises.prompt: "她每天都在朋友圈曬娃" means ___
exercises.answer: She posts photos of her kid on Moments every day
acceptableAnswers: She shows off her kid on WeChat Moments daily
She's always sharing baby photos on Moments
exercises.explanation: 曬 (shài) on social media = to flaunt / show off. 曬娃 = post kid pics. 曬美食 = post food photos.

exercises.prompt: Tap the social-media verb you hear
exercises.answer: 點 贊
exercises.explanation: 點贊 (diǎn zàn) — to like / give a thumbs-up. The signature WeChat / Weibo gesture.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "I rarely post on Moments now":
options: 我現在很少發朋友圈了
exercises.answer: 我現在很少發朋友圈了
exercises.explanation: 很少 + V (rarely do V), with sentence-final 了 marking the changed state — "I'm no longer the type who posts much".

lessons.title: 996 & overtime culture
lessons.description: 加班, 996, 壓力, 通宵 — the long-hours vocabulary

exercises.prompt: What does "996" (jiǔ jiǔ liù) refer to?
exercises.answer: Working 9am-9pm, 6 days a week
exercises.explanation: 996 became a flashpoint in Chinese tech around 2019. The phrase 996.icu — "work 996, end up in the ICU" — went viral.

exercises.prompt: the long-hours term
Build "I have to work overtime almost every day"
exercises.answer: 我 幾乎 每天 都 要 加班

exercises.prompt: "壓力很大" (yā lì hěn dà) means ___
exercises.answer: The pressure is heavy
acceptableAnswers: I am under a lot of pressure

exercises.prompt: Build "To finish the project, I pulled an all-nighter"
exercises.answer: 為 了 完成 專案 我 通宵 了
exercises.explanation: 通宵 (tōng xiāo) literally "through the night" — verb or noun. 哎 / 哎呀 commonly precede a complaint about it: 哎呀，又通宵了.

exercises.prompt: Pick the casual vs formal: 996 critique in a casual chat with a friend:
options: 鄙人深感996對身心健康存在危害
996機制對從業人員產生負面影響
exercises.answer: 996真不是人乾的
exercises.explanation: Casual register: 真不是人乾的 ("this isn't fit for humans") is colloquial complaint. The other options are essay/formal versions of the same idea.

exercises.prompt: Build a compound sentence: "Although the salary is high, the pressure is enormous" (儘管...但是)
exercises.answer: 儘管 工資 很 高 但是 壓力 非常 大

exercises.prompt: "打工人" (dǎ gōng rén) refers to ___
exercises.answer: Wage workers / regular working people
exercises.explanation: 打工人 — viral meme term. Working folks calling themselves "the laboring people" with a mix of pride and self-mockery. 打工人, 打工魂, 打工都是人上人.

exercises.prompt: the workplace stress vocab
Best translation for "I've been overworked recently":
options: All of the above could work
exercises.answer: All of the above could work
exercises.explanation: Spoken Chinese has many ways to express the same complaint at different registers — 太累了 (casual), 工作過度 (medical/formal), 壓力很大 (stress-focused).

exercises.prompt: Build "The more I work overtime, the more exhausted I become" (越...越)
exercises.answer: 我 越 加班 越 累

exercises.prompt: Your boss WeChats: 這個專案今晚能搞定嗎？ Pick the appropriate reply for a formal workplace.
exercises.answer: 好的，我會盡力今晚完成。
acceptableAnswers: 好的 我會盡力今晚完成
好的，我盡力在今晚完成
好的，我會努力今晚完成
exercises.explanation: 好的 + 盡力 + 完成 is the standard non-committal-but-positive reply. Casual 行 / 沒問題 sounds too breezy when the boss is pushing a deadline.

exercises.prompt: Tap the workplace term you hear
exercises.answer: 加 班
exercises.explanation: 加班 (jiā bān, work overtime) and 上班 (shàng bān, go to work) start with different first syllables. The complaint volume is also a clue — 加班 carries more sigh.

lessons.title: Internet labor slang: 內卷, 躺平, 裸辭
lessons.description: From the involution treadmill to lying flat — newer workplace memes

exercises.prompt: the internet labor slang

pairs.right: Involution / cutthroat competition for diminishing returns
Letting it rot / phoning it in

exercises.prompt: Build "He has chosen to lie flat"
exercises.answer: 他 選擇 躺平

exercises.prompt: Build "Young people today are in really fierce involution"
exercises.answer: 現在 年輕 人 內卷 得 很 厲害
exercises.explanation: 內卷 used as a verb takes 得 + degree complement, like other stative verbs.

exercises.prompt: Tap the term you hear
exercises.answer: 內卷
exercises.explanation: 內卷 (nèi juǎn, involution) and 內涵 (nèi hán, connotation / hidden meaning) sound similar — listen for the second syllable. 卷 has a falling-rising tone; 涵 has a rising tone.

exercises.prompt: "他乾脆裸辭了" means ___
exercises.answer: He just quit outright with no backup plan
acceptableAnswers: He simply quit without a backup
exercises.explanation: 裸辭 (luǒ cí) — literally "naked resign". 乾脆 (gān cuì) here = "just outright".

exercises.prompt: Best translation of "I'm not lying flat, I'm just resting":
options: 我不是躺平，我只是在休息
exercises.answer: 我不是躺平，我只是在休息
exercises.explanation: Common comeback when accused of 躺平. The 不是X，只是Y frame distances yourself from the negative label.

exercises.prompt: Build "In an involution environment, even hard work can't change anything" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 在 內卷 的 環境 裡 即使 努力 也 改變 不 了 什麼

exercises.prompt: "卷不動了" (juǎn bù dòng le) means ___
exercises.answer: I can't keep up with the involution anymore
acceptableAnswers: I'm too exhausted to compete anymore
I can't run on this treadmill anymore
exercises.explanation: 卷不動 — potential complement: 卷 (compete in involution) + 不動 (can't physically move). 了 marks the give-up moment.

exercises.prompt: the labor-attitude meme to its English vibe

pairs.right: Letting it rot / phoning it in

exercises.prompt: Build "I'd rather lie flat than continue with the involution"
exercises.answer: 我 寧願 躺平 也 不 想 繼續 內卷
exercises.explanation: 寧願X也不Y — "would rather X than Y". A B2 staple for stating preferences strongly.

exercises.prompt: Pick the casual / colloquial register:
options: 鑑於工作環境過於內卷化，本人選擇以躺平方式回應
據觀察當下職場內卷現象較為嚴重
exercises.answer: 我不捲了，我躺平
exercises.explanation: 我不捲了，我躺平 is exactly how a friend would say it on WeChat. The other options are mock-formal essay or news-register variations.

exercises.prompt: "雞娃" (jī wá) refers to ___
exercises.answer: Pushing kids hard / tiger-parenting them
exercises.explanation: 雞娃 literally "chicken-blood the kid" — a slang verb for parents who heavily structure their kids' study schedules with extracurriculars and tutoring.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the older generation can't understand 'lying flat', young people understand each other" (儘管...但是)
exercises.answer: 儘管 上 一 代 不 理解 躺平 但是 年輕 人 互相 理解

lessons.title: AI & the future
lessons.description: 人工智慧 and the 用 X 來 Y instrument pattern

exercises.prompt: What does "人工智慧" (rén gōng zhì néng) mean?
exercises.answer: Artificial intelligence

exercises.prompt: Build "AI will change our way of life" (news/tech register)
exercises.answer: 人工智慧 將 改變 我們 的 生活 方式
exercises.explanation: 將 (jiāng) is the formal/news-register "will" — preferred over 會 in tech and journalistic writing.

exercises.prompt: "機器人" (jī qì rén) means ___
exercises.answer: Robot

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Many jobs may be replaced by AI":
options: 很多工作可能會被人工智慧取代
exercises.answer: 很多工作可能會被人工智慧取代
exercises.explanation: 被 marks the passive: the jobs are replaced (by AI).

exercises.prompt: Build "I use my phone to pay" (用 X 來 Y instrument pattern)
exercises.answer: 我 用 手機 來 支付
exercises.explanation: 用 X 來 Y — "use X to do Y". X is the instrument, Y is the action. 來 links them; in casual speech it's often dropped (我用手機支付), but 來 makes the instrumental relationship explicit.

exercises.prompt: Pick the best translation of "We can use AI to solve many problems":
options: 我們可以用人工智慧來解決很多問題
我們人工智慧很多問題
我們解決人工智慧問題
exercises.answer: 我們可以用人工智慧來解決很多問題

exercises.prompt: the AI / tech term
"機器翻譯越來越準確" means ___
exercises.answer: Machine translation is getting more and more accurate
acceptableAnswers: Machine translation keeps getting more accurate

exercises.prompt: Build "Although AI is powerful, it can't replace humans" (儘管...但是)
exercises.answer: 儘管 人工智慧 很 強大 但是 不 能 取代 人類

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "AI not only changes work but also changes how we live" (不僅...而且):
options: 人工智慧不僅改變工作，而且改變我們的生活方式
人工智慧但是工作生活
exercises.answer: 人工智慧不僅改變工作，而且改變我們的生活方式

exercises.prompt: "AI 搶 工作" (AI qiǎng gōng zuò) — what does this mean?
exercises.answer: AI is taking jobs
exercises.explanation: 搶 = snatch / grab. Casual/news-headline phrasing for the AI-replaces-jobs anxiety.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if AI develops fast, ethics issues still need to be considered" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 即使 人工智慧 發展 得 很 快 也 需要 考慮 倫理 問題

exercises.prompt: Tap the AI-related word you hear
exercises.answer: 算 法
exercises.explanation: 演算法 (suàn fǎ) — algorithm. Easy to confuse with 算數 (count / arithmetic). The second syllable is the giveaway.

exercises.prompt: Tap the term you hear
exercises.answer: 高 考
exercises.explanation: 高考 (gāo kǎo) — the dreaded national college-entrance exam. Don't confuse with 高中 (gāo zhōng, senior high).

lessons.title: The gaokao
lessons.description: 高考 — the test that decides everything

exercises.prompt: What is "高考" (gāo kǎo)?
exercises.answer: China's national college entrance exam

exercises.prompt: Build "He studies very hard every day to prepare for the gaokao"
exercises.answer: 他 每天 都 很 努力 學習 準備 高考

exercises.prompt: the term
"考上了" (kǎo shàng le) means ___
exercises.answer: Got in / passed and got admitted
exercises.explanation: 上 here is a result complement: tested-onto = got in.

exercises.prompt: What does "應試教育" (yìng shì jiào yù) refer to?
exercises.answer: Test-driven / exam-oriented education
exercises.explanation: 應試教育 — the Chinese term for the exam-cramming model. Frequently critiqued in op-eds. Contrast with 素質教育 ("holistic / whole-person education").

exercises.prompt: the gaokao culture term

pairs.right: Repeat senior year to retake gaokao

exercises.prompt: Build "In order to take the gaokao, he gave up many things"
exercises.answer: 為 了 高考 他 放棄 了 很 多 東西

exercises.prompt: "千軍萬馬過獨木橋" describes the gaokao because ___
exercises.answer: Thousands of soldiers crossing a single-plank bridge — fierce competition
acceptableAnswers: An army crossing a one-plank bridge
Huge numbers competing for few spots
exercises.explanation: 千軍萬馬過獨木橋 — classic chengyu metaphor for the gaokao bottleneck.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most NUANCED critique of exam-oriented education:
options: 應試教育雖然能篩選學生，但是忽視了創造力的培養
exercises.answer: 應試教育雖然能篩選學生，但是忽視了創造力的培養
exercises.explanation: Concede a point (能篩選學生) then criticize (忽視了創造力的培養). The 雖然...但是 frame is the standard B2 essay move.

exercises.prompt: Build "He has been preparing for the gaokao for three years" (verb-doubling for duration)
exercises.answer: 他 準備 高考 準備 了 三 年

exercises.prompt: "我不想再捲了" (in education context) means ___
exercises.answer: I don't want to compete in this rat race anymore
acceptableAnswers: I don't want to keep grinding
I'm tired of this academic competition
exercises.explanation: 卷 = participate in 內卷 (involution). 再...了 = anymore.

exercises.prompt: Tap the gaokao-culture word you hear
exercises.answer: 狀 元
exercises.explanation: 狀元 (zhuàng yuán) — historically the imperial-exam top scorer; now the title for each province's top gaokao scorer. 4th tone + 2nd tone.

lessons.title: Studying abroad
lessons.description: 出國留學 — the dream of many

exercises.prompt: What does "留學" (liú xué) mean?
exercises.answer: Study abroad

exercises.prompt: Build "My older sister is studying abroad in the US"
exercises.answer: 我 姐姐 在 美國 留學

exercises.prompt: "獎學金" (jiǎng xué jīn) means ___
exercises.answer: Scholarship

exercises.prompt: the studying-abroad term
What does "海歸" (hǎi guī) literally and figuratively mean?
options: Sea turtle / Chinese person who studied abroad and returned
exercises.answer: Sea turtle / Chinese person who studied abroad and returned
exercises.explanation: Pun on 海龜 (sea turtle, same pronunciation). 海歸 = those who 'return from overseas'. Cultural shorthand for ambitious returnees.

exercises.prompt: Build "She got admitted to a top US university"
exercises.answer: 她 被 美國 一 所 頂尖 大學 錄取 了
exercises.explanation: 被 marks the passive: she 'was admitted'. 所 is the measure word for schools/houses.

exercises.prompt: "出國留學" means ___
exercises.answer: Go abroad to study

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Studying abroad isn't just for academics, it's also a life experience" (不僅...而且 / 還):
options: 留學不僅是為了學習，還是一種人生經歷
exercises.answer: 留學不僅是為了學習，還是一種人生經歷

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the cost of studying abroad is high, the experience is worth it" (雖然...但是)
exercises.answer: 雖然 留學 費用 很 高 但是 經歷 很 值得

exercises.prompt: "我想去國外開開眼界" means ___
exercises.answer: I want to go abroad and broaden my horizons
acceptableAnswers: I want to go overseas to widen my view
I want to broaden my horizons abroad
exercises.explanation: 開眼界 — "open one's eyes/scope". The doubled verb 開開 softens it: "have a look" / "check it out".

exercises.prompt: the application-process step
Tap the term you hear
exercises.answer: 留 學
exercises.explanation: 留學 (liú xué) — to study abroad. The first character is 留 (stay/remain), implying "stay (overseas) to study".

lessons.title: Lifelong learning
lessons.description: Talk about what and why you study

exercises.prompt: Build "I think learning a foreign language is very important"
exercises.answer: 我 覺得 學 一 門 外語 非常 重要

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "I've studied Chinese for three years"?
exercises.answer: 我學中文學了三年
exercises.explanation: Verb-duplication pattern: V-object V-了-time. The verb gets repeated to take the duration phrase.

exercises.prompt: "活到老，學到老" means ___
exercises.answer: Live to old age, learn to old age
exercises.explanation: A famous proverb — the closest English equivalent is "you're never too old to learn".

exercises.prompt: the online-learning term
What does "自學成才" (zì xué chéng cái) mean?
exercises.answer: Self-taught and successful
exercises.explanation: Chengyu: 自學 (self-study) + 成才 (become talented). Used to praise self-made experts.

exercises.prompt: Build "The more I study, the more I realize how little I know"
exercises.answer: 我 越 學 越 發現 自己 知道 得 太 少

exercises.prompt: "學歷" (xué lì) means ___
exercises.answer: Academic credentials / level of education

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Online learning is convenient, but it lacks interaction":
options: 網課很方便，但是缺少互動
exercises.answer: 網課很方便，但是缺少互動

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if you graduate, you should keep learning" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 即使 畢 業 了 也 應該 繼續 學習

exercises.prompt: "知識就是力量" (zhī shí jiù shì lì liàng) means ___
exercises.answer: Knowledge is power

exercises.prompt: Build a casual recommendation: "I think there are many free courses online, you should check them out"
exercises.answer: 我 覺得 網上 有 很 多 免費 課程 你 應該 看 看

exercises.prompt: Tap the lifelong-learning term you hear
exercises.spokenText: 終 身 學 習
options: 終 身 學 習
中 學 學 習
終 究 學 習
眾 生 學 習
exercises.answer: 終 身 學 習
exercises.explanation: 終身學習 (zhōng shēn xué xí) — formal term for lifelong learning. 終身 = whole life. The casual equivalent would be 活到老學到老.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Parent-teacher meeting about your kid
lessons.description: Ask about weak points and agree on a plan with the teacher

exercises.prompt: Sitting down with Xiao Ming's teacher for the term review

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: 您好，謝謝您今天能來。小明最近上課比較積極。(Nín hǎo, xièxiè nín jīntiān néng lái. Xiǎo Míng zuìjìn shàngkè bǐjiào jījí.)
turns.spokenText: 您好，謝謝您今天能來。小明最近上課比較積極。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Respond politely and ask about weak points.
options: 謝謝老師，那他還有哪些方面需要加強？(Xièxiè lǎoshī, nà tā hái yǒu nǎxiē fāngmiàn xūyào jiāqiáng?)
知道了那他到底哪裡不行說說。(Zhīdào le nà tā dàodǐ nǎlǐ bùxíng shuōshuo.)
老師不需要因為加強方面。(Lǎoshī bù xūyào yīnwèi jiāqiáng fāngmiàn.)
turns.answer: 謝謝老師，那他還有哪些方面需要加強？(Xièxiè lǎoshī, nà tā hái yǒu nǎxiē fāngmiàn xūyào jiāqiáng?)

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: 數學還行，但是作文似乎不太敢表達自己。(Shùxué hái xíng, dànshì zuòwén sìhū bù tài gǎn biǎodá zìjǐ.)
turns.spokenText: 數學還行，但是作文似乎不太敢表達自己。

turns.speaker: you
turns.after: 他在家話不多，其實想法挺多的。(___ tā zài jiā huà bù duō, qíshí xiǎngfǎ tǐng duō de.)
turns.answer: 雖然

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: 原來如此，那我們一起想辦法鼓勵他。(Yuánlái rúcǐ, nà wǒmen yīqǐ xiǎng bànfǎ gǔlì tā.)
turns.spokenText: 原來如此，那我們一起想辦法鼓勵他。

turns.speaker: you
options: 我們也許可以讓他每週寫一篇小日記。(Wǒmen yěxǔ kěyǐ ràng tā měi zhōu xiě yī piān xiǎo rìjì.)
強迫他每天寫十篇必須完成。(Qiángpò tā měitiān xiě shí piān bìxū wánchéng.)
日記不需要因為也許每週。(Rìjì bù xūyào yīnwèi yěxǔ měi zhōu.)
turns.answer: 我們也許可以讓他每週寫一篇小日記。(Wǒmen yěxǔ kěyǐ ràng tā měi zhōu xiě yī piān xiǎo rìjì.)

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: 這個想法不錯，我也會在課上多請他發言。(Zhège xiǎngfǎ bùcuò, wǒ yě huì zài kè shàng duō qǐng tā fāyán.)
turns.spokenText: 這個想法不錯，我也會在課上多請他發言。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Thank the teacher and close formally.
options: 非常感謝您的耐心，我們家長也會配合。(Fēicháng gǎnxiè nín de nàixīn, wǒmen jiāzhǎng yě huì pèihé.)
行吧那就這樣吧拜拜了您。(Xíng ba nà jiù zhèyàng ba báibái le nín.)
感謝不需要因為配合家長。(Gǎnxiè bù xūyào yīnwèi pèihé jiāzhǎng.)
turns.answer: 非常感謝您的耐心，我們家長也會配合。(Fēicháng gǎnxiè nín de nàixīn, wǒmen jiāzhǎng yě huì pèihé.)

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: 好的，有進展我會隨時跟您溝通。(Hǎo de, yǒu jìnzhǎn wǒ huì suíshí gēn nín gōutōng.)
turns.spokenText: 好的，有進展我會隨時跟您溝通。

topics.title: Friendship & relationships
topics.description: Close friends, dating, and getting along

lessons.title: Types of friends
lessons.description: From 同事 to 閨蜜

exercises.prompt: the relationship
What does "發小" (fà xiǎor) mean?
exercises.answer: Childhood friend (grew up together)
exercises.explanation: Colloquially pronounced with érhuà — 發小兒 (fà xiǎor) — especially in northern Mandarin.

exercises.prompt: "我們認識很多年了" means ___
exercises.answer: We have known each other for many years
acceptableAnswers: We've known each other for years

exercises.prompt: the friendship type

pairs.right: Soulmate / true friend who knows you

exercises.prompt: What does "塑膠姐妹花" (sù liào jiě mèi huā) mean?
exercises.answer: Fake / two-faced female friendship
exercises.explanation: Internet slang: 塑膠 = plastic = fake. 姐妹花 = pair of female friends. Used jokingly when girlfriends pretend to support each other but actually compete.

exercises.prompt: Build "He's my best friend, we tell each other everything"
exercises.answer: 他 是 我 最 好 的 朋友 我們 什麼 都 聊

exercises.prompt: "我們一拍即合" (wǒ men yī pāi jí hé) means ___
exercises.answer: We hit it off immediately
exercises.explanation: Chengyu: 一拍 (one clap) 即 (immediately) 合 (in tune). Used when friendship sparks at first meeting.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Although we don't see each other often, we're still good friends" (雖然...但是):
options: 雖然我們不常見面，但是還是好朋友
exercises.answer: 雖然我們不常見面，但是還是好朋友

exercises.prompt: Build "My coworkers and I get along really well"
exercises.answer: 我 跟 同事 們 相處 得 很 好

exercises.prompt: "鄰居" (lín jū) means ___
exercises.answer: Neighbor

exercises.prompt: Tap the relationship word you hear
exercises.answer: 閨 蜜
exercises.explanation: 閨蜜 (guī mì) — best girlfriend / BFF (female only). Listen for the high-falling 蜜 in the second syllable.

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal/written register for "friend":
exercises.answer: 好友
exercises.explanation: 好友 is the literary / formal version. 哥們兒 is northern slang. 朋友 is neutral. 兄弟 is male-only and macho-casual.

lessons.title: Getting along
lessons.description: 相處, 合得來, 吵架

exercises.prompt: What does "合得來" (hé de lái) mean?
exercises.answer: Get along well

exercises.prompt: Build "He and I get along really well"
exercises.answer: 他 跟 我 特別 合得來

exercises.prompt: the verb
"我們昨天吵架了" means ___
exercises.answer: We argued yesterday

exercises.prompt: What does the pattern "一…就…" (yī…jiù…) mean?
options: As soon as A, then B / The moment A happens, B happens
exercises.answer: As soon as A, then B / The moment A happens, B happens
exercises.explanation: 一 X 就 Y — "the moment X, Y." Both clauses can share or have different subjects. Common in everyday narration: 我一回家就睡覺 (the moment I get home, I sleep).

exercises.prompt: Build "As soon as we met, we became good friends"
exercises.answer: 我們 一 見面 就 成 了 好 朋友

exercises.prompt: "他一喝酒就說很多話" means ___
exercises.answer: As soon as he drinks, he talks a lot
acceptableAnswers: The moment he drinks, he talks a lot
Whenever he drinks, he gets talkative

exercises.prompt: the relationship-dynamic verb
Best translation for "My coworker and I had a misunderstanding, but it's resolved now":
options: 我和同事有過誤會，但是現在解決了
exercises.answer: 我和同事有過誤會，但是現在解決了

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if he doesn't understand me, I won't give up on this friendship" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 即使 他 不 理解 我 我 也 不 會 放棄 這 段 友誼
exercises.explanation: 段 is the measure word for relationships and stretches of time/experience: 一段感情, 一段時間, 一段友誼.

exercises.prompt: "他對我很有耐心" means ___
exercises.answer: He's very patient with me
acceptableAnswers: He has a lot of patience with me
He shows me a lot of patience

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb you hear
exercises.answer: 吵 架
exercises.explanation: 吵架 (chǎo jià) = argue / quarrel. 打架 (dǎ jià) = physical fight. The first syllable is the differentiator.

lessons.title: Dating
lessons.description: 談戀愛, 表白, 分手

exercises.prompt: the dating term
Best translation for "They've been together for two years":
exercises.answer: 他們在一起兩年了
exercises.explanation: 在一起 (zài yī qǐ) — together. The 了 at the end signals the duration is ongoing.

exercises.prompt: "我對她有好感" (wǒ duì tā yǒu hǎo gǎn) means ___
exercises.answer: I have a crush on her / I have a positive feeling about her
acceptableAnswers: I have a good impression of her

exercises.prompt: the dating slang

pairs.right: Go on an arranged blind date

exercises.prompt: What does "撩" (liáo) mean in dating context?
exercises.answer: Flirt with / tease
exercises.explanation: 撩 — internet/dating slang: hit on someone, flirt. 撩妹 = flirt with girls, 撩漢 = flirt with guys.

exercises.prompt: Build "He keeps liking my posts on Moments"
exercises.answer: 他 一直 給 我 的 朋友圈 點贊
exercises.explanation: Modern flirting: relentless 點贊 on someone's 朋友圈 = persistent low-key pursuit. 一直給X點贊 is the standard way to call this out.

exercises.prompt: "他在跟我玩曖昧" means ___
exercises.answer: He's playing the ambiguous game with me / leading me on
exercises.explanation: 曖昧 (ài mèi) — "ambiguous" — referring to that flirty in-between phase. 玩曖昧 = playing without committing.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "They argue often, but they never break up" (雖然...但是):
options: 他們雖然經常吵架，但是從來沒分手
exercises.answer: 他們雖然經常吵架，但是從來沒分手

exercises.prompt: Build "My parents went on a blind date and got married"
exercises.answer: 我 父母 是 相親 結婚 的
exercises.explanation: 是…的 frame highlights HOW the action happened — 是相親結婚的 = "it was via blind date that they married".

exercises.prompt: "他們已經在一起三年了" means ___
exercises.answer: They have been together for three years
acceptableAnswers: They've been a couple for three years

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if we're far apart, our love won't change" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 即使 我們 相 隔 很 遠 我們 的 感情 也 不 會 變

exercises.prompt: Tap the dating term you hear
exercises.answer: 脫 單
exercises.explanation: 脫單 (tuō dān) — escape singleness. 單身 = single, 脫 = escape from. The 雙十一 / 七夕 holiday goal of many.

lessons.title: Friendships in deeper Chinese
lessons.description: Idioms and longer sentences

exercises.prompt: Build "A true friend will always support you"
exercises.answer: 真正 的 朋友 永遠 會 支援 你

exercises.prompt: What does "患難見真情" (huàn nàn jiàn zhēn qíng) mean?
exercises.answer: Hard times reveal true friendship
exercises.explanation: A four-character set phrase: lit. "hardship reveals true feeling".

exercises.prompt: "我們什麼都聊" means ___
exercises.answer: We talk about everything

exercises.prompt: the friendship-quality chengyu

pairs.right: True friends — sharing liver and gallbladder (loyalty)

exercises.prompt: What does "君子之交淡如水" (jūn zǐ zhī jiāo dàn rú shuǐ) mean?
options: True friendship is plain / unembellished, like water
exercises.answer: True friendship is plain / unembellished, like water
exercises.explanation: Classic chengyu: a noble person's friendship is light/plain like water — no flashy obligations, no hidden agenda. Endures.

exercises.prompt: Build "A real friend not only celebrates with you, but also stays during hard times" (不僅...而且)
exercises.answer: 真正 的 朋友 不僅 會 跟 你 一起 慶祝 而且 會 在 困難 時 陪伴 你

exercises.prompt: "我有什麼事都跟她說" means ___
exercises.answer: I tell her about everything that happens
acceptableAnswers: Whatever happens to me, I tell her
exercises.explanation: 什麼事 + 都 = whatever happens. 都 here is the universal/inclusive marker.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "As I get older, my friends are getting fewer":
exercises.answer: 我越長大，朋友越少
exercises.explanation: Two-subject 越...越 — first clause about me, second about friends. Different subjects, both inside the pattern.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although we live in different cities, we're still close" (儘管...但是)
exercises.answer: 儘管 我們 住 在 不同 的 城市 但是 關係 還 是 很 好

exercises.prompt: "友誼地久天長" (yǒu yì dì jiǔ tiān cháng) means ___
exercises.answer: May our friendship last forever
acceptableAnswers: Friendship as long as heaven and earth
exercises.explanation: The Chinese title of "Auld Lang Syne". 地久天長 = as enduring as heaven and earth.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most warm/touching way to thank a friend:
exercises.answer: 有你這個朋友真好
exercises.explanation: 有你這個朋友真好 — "having you as a friend is so wonderful". A standard appreciation phrase that lands warmly without being saccharine.

exercises.prompt: Tap the chengyu you hear
exercises.spokenText: 患 難 見 真 情
options: 患 難 見 真 情
歡 喜 真 朋 友
時 間 見 真 情
幻 想 見 真 情
exercises.answer: 患 難 見 真 情
exercises.explanation: 患難見真情 — "hardship reveals true feeling". A four-character set phrase common in writing about loyal friendship.

lessons.title: How long have you been doing it?
lessons.description: Time-duration with verb-doubling: 我 學 中文 學 了 三 年

exercises.prompt: Why does 學 appear twice in "我學中文學了三年"?
options: When a verb has an object, you repeat the verb to attach a duration phrase
exercises.answer: When a verb has an object, you repeat the verb to attach a duration phrase
exercises.explanation: Pattern: Subject + V + Object + V + 了 + Duration. The doubled verb is what carries 了 and the time phrase.

exercises.prompt: Build "I have studied Chinese for three years"
exercises.answer: 我 學 中文 學 了 三 年

exercises.prompt: Build "We have known each other for ten years"
exercises.answer: 我們 認識 認識 了 十 年

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
options: 我看電視看了兩個小時
exercises.answer: 我學中文了三年
exercises.explanation: If you keep the object 中文 right after the verb, you must repeat the verb for the duration: 學中文學了三年. Otherwise drop the object: 我學了三年中文.

exercises.prompt: "他打籃球打了一個下午" means ___
exercises.answer: He played basketball for an entire afternoon
acceptableAnswers: He spent a whole afternoon playing basketball
exercises.explanation: Same pattern: V (打) + Obj (籃球) + V (打) + 了 + duration (一個下午).

exercises.prompt: Build "They have been together for two years"
exercises.answer: 他們 在 一起 在 一起 了 兩 年

topics.title: Emotions in depth
topics.description: Beyond happy and sad — frustrated, moved, embarrassed, even-if-I

guide.intro: B2 emotions need B2 grammar. The patterns 即使…也 (even if…still) and 尽管 (although) let you say things like "even if I'm tired, I'll still finish" and "although I'm sad, I'm okay" — exactly the kind of nuance you start needing once you go past 我很高兴.

sections.text: 即使…也 — even if…still

即使 (jí shǐ) introduces a hypothetical or extreme condition; the second half always uses 也 (yě, "still") or 還 (hái) to mark that the result holds regardless. Without that 也, the sentence sounds incomplete to a native ear.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, I'll still go.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ hěn lèi, tā yě bù fàng qì.
rows.translation: Even if he's tired, he doesn't give up.

rows.source: 即使沒有錢，我也很快樂。
rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ méi yǒu qián, wǒ yě hěn kuài lè.
rows.translation: Even without money, I'm still happy.

sections.text: 即使 is for hypotheticals ("even if it rains") — events that may or may not happen. 即便 (jí biàn) is a slightly more formal synonym you'll see in writing.
儘管…但是 — although

儘管 (jǐn guǎn) introduces an actual fact (not a hypothetical), and 但是 (dàn shì, "but") or 還是 (hái shi, "still") marks the contrasting follow-up. Use 儘管 when the first clause is true and the second clause is the surprise.

rows.source: 儘管下雨，他還是去跑步了。
rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn xià yǔ, tā hái shi qù pǎo bù le.
rows.translation: Although it was raining, he still went running.

rows.source: 儘管我們很努力，但是沒有成功。
rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wǒ men hěn nǔ lì, dàn shì méi yǒu chéng gōng.
rows.translation: Although we tried hard, we didn't succeed.

exercises.explanation: These particles carry tone, not vocabulary. Sprinkle them into casual speech; remove them all from formal writing.

Build "I felt extremely disappointed today"

exercises.answer: I feel really bad inside

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "I'm slightly nervous" (mild):
exercises.answer: 我有點緊張
exercises.explanation: Match degree to context: 有點 (a bit) is the mild option. The other three are all strong.

exercises.prompt: the emotion idiom to its meaning

pairs.right: Heart like being cut by a knife (devastating sorrow)

exercises.prompt: Build "That moment was incredibly awkward"

exercises.answer: I'm speechless / I don't even know what to say
acceptableAnswers: I'm at a loss for words
exercises.explanation: 無語了 — internet-popularized expression of being too exasperated to speak. Common reaction to bad news / silly behavior.

exercises.prompt: Tap the emotion you hear
exercises.answer: 感 動
exercises.explanation: 感動 (gǎn dòng) — moved/touched. The second syllable 動 (4th tone) is the differentiator from 感謝 (gǎn xiè, thanks).

lessons.title: Even if (即使…也)
lessons.description: Stand firm against a hypothetical

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it rains, I'll still go"
exercises.answer: 即使 下雨 我 也 要 去

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 即使他來，我不去
exercises.explanation: 即使 must pair with 也 / 還 in the second clause. Dropping 也 leaves the sentence feeling unfinished.

exercises.prompt: "即使很累，他也不放棄" means ___
exercises.answer: Even when tired, he doesn't give up
acceptableAnswers: Even if he's tired, he won't give up
Even though tired, he doesn't give up

exercises.prompt: What's the obligatory partner of 即使?
exercises.answer: 也 / 還
exercises.explanation: 即使...也 / 還 is the locked frame. Without 也 / 還, the sentence sounds incomplete.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if no one supports me, I'll still keep going"
exercises.answer: 即使 沒 有 人 支援 我 我 也 會 堅持 下去

exercises.prompt: "即使沒有錢，我也很快樂" means ___
exercises.answer: Even without money, I'm still happy
acceptableAnswers: Even if I have no money, I'm happy
I'm happy even when I don't have money

exercises.prompt: Pick the GRAMMATICALLY VALID 即使 sentence:
exercises.answer: 即使下雨，我還是要去
exercises.explanation: 即使 pairs only with 也 / 還 / 還是. 但是, 因為, 所以 don't fit.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if you don't agree, I'll still do it"
exercises.answer: 即使 你 不 同意 我 也 會 這麼 做

exercises.prompt: the conditional pattern to its meaning
"即便" (jí biàn) is a ___ synonym for 即使.
exercises.answer: Slightly more formal / written
exercises.explanation: 即便 = same meaning as 即使, slightly preferred in written/essay register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it costs a lot, this experience is worth it"
exercises.answer: 即使 花 很 多 錢 這 段 經歷 也 值得

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector you hear
exercises.answer: 即 使
exercises.explanation: 即使 (jí shǐ, 2nd + 3rd tone) starts with the rising 即. 即便 also starts with 即 but has falling 便. Practice the contrast.

lessons.title: Although (儘管…但是)
lessons.description: Real-world contrast

exercises.prompt: When do you use 儘管 instead of 即使?
options: 儘管 = hypothetical; 即使 = real
儘管 = real fact; 即使 = hypothetical
exercises.answer: 儘管 = real fact; 即使 = hypothetical

exercises.prompt: Build "Although we tried hard, we didn't succeed"
exercises.answer: 儘管 我們 很 努力 但是 沒有 成功
exercises.explanation: 儘管 X 但是 Y. The follow-up word can also be 還是 or 仍然 ("still") — e.g. 儘管下雨，他還是去了 / 儘管累，我仍然要做完.

exercises.prompt: "儘管下雨，他還是去跑步了" means ___
exercises.answer: Although it was raining, he still went running
acceptableAnswers: Even though it rained, he still went running
Despite the rain, he still went running

exercises.prompt: Tap the word you hear
exercises.answer: 儘管
exercises.explanation: 儘管 (jǐn guǎn) and 即使 (jí shǐ) both translate as "even though/if" — but they sound very different. 儘管 starts with a 3rd-tone 盡; 即使 starts with a 2nd-tone 即. Train the ear before the grammar.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence requires 儘管 (NOT 即使)? (a real fact)
exercises.answer: ___ 我累，我還是會做完
exercises.explanation: If "I'm tired" is presented as a current real fact, use 儘管. The other three are hypotheticals — 即使 territory.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although I'm tired, I'll still finish my work" (儘管...還是)
exercises.answer: 儘管 我 很 累 我 還 是 會 做 完 工作

exercises.prompt: Convert formal 儘管 sentence: 儘管下雨，他還是去跑步了。 To CASUAL conversational form, swap 儘管 → ___
exercises.answer: 雖然
exercises.explanation: 雖然 is the everyday spoken equivalent of 儘管. 儘管 carries a slightly more written tone. Both pair with 但是 / 還是.

exercises.prompt: the contrast connector to its register
Build "Although the work is hard, the salary is good"
exercises.answer: 雖然 工作 很 辛苦 但是 工資 不錯

exercises.prompt: "儘管如此" (jǐn guǎn rú cǐ) means ___
exercises.answer: Despite this / nevertheless
exercises.explanation: 儘管如此 — fixed phrase used at clause boundary to introduce a contrast. The 如此 means "like this".

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Despite the heavy rain, the event still went ahead":
options: 儘管下大雨，活動還是照常進行
exercises.answer: 儘管下大雨，活動還是照常進行
exercises.explanation: 照常 (zhào cháng) — "as usual / as scheduled". A common essay-register word.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although she lost, she's still smiling"
exercises.answer: 雖然 她 輸 了 但是 她 還 是 在 笑

exercises.prompt: What does "這部電影讓我很感動" mean?

exercises.prompt: "她的話讓我很失望" means ___

Her words made me very disappointed

exercises.prompt: the 讓 + person + emotion pattern to its meaning

pairs.right: This movie is moving (makes one moved)

exercises.prompt: Build "What you did made me extremely disappointed"

exercises.prompt: "令" (lìng) is a more formal version of which word?
exercises.answer: 讓
exercises.explanation: 令 = formal/written equivalent of 讓 ("to make / cause"). 這令我感到驚訝 (this makes me surprised) is essay-register.

exercises.prompt: Which is the FORMAL register version?
exercises.answer: 此事令本人深感煩惱
exercises.explanation: 此事 (this matter), 本人 (I, formal), 令 (make), 深感 (deeply feel) — all formal/written swaps for casual 這事兒/我/讓/覺得.

exercises.explanation: 對...感到 + emotion: a slightly more formal frame than 讓 + person + emotion. Often used in writing.

exercises.prompt: What does "難道" (nán dào) add to a question?

options: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.answer: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.explanation: 難道 + statement + 嗎 = pushy rhetorical question. 難道你不知道嗎？ = "Don't tell me you don't know!" The expected answer is "of course I do".

exercises.prompt: Build a rhetorical question: "Don't you think this is unfair?"
exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 覺得 這 不 公平 嗎

exercises.prompt: "哪裡有這樣的道理？" (nǎ lǐ yǒu zhè yàng de dào lǐ) is a ___ question.
exercises.answer: Rhetorical (expressing protest / no way)
exercises.explanation: 哪裡 (nǎ lǐ) here is rhetorical, not asking "where". Means "how could there be such a logic?!" — a sharp pushback.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "How could you say something like that?" (rhetorical):
exercises.answer: 你怎麼能說出這種話？
exercises.explanation: 怎麼能 — "how could (you)" — is the standard structure for outraged rhetorical questions.

exercises.prompt: Build "Why do you say it this way?"
exercises.answer: 你 為 什麼 這麼 說

exercises.prompt: the question type to its tone
"這怎麼可能呢？" (zhè zěn me kě néng ne) means ___
exercises.answer: How could this be possible?
acceptableAnswers: There's no way this is possible
exercises.explanation: 怎麼可能 — incredulous protest. The 呢 at the end softens it from outrage to genuine bafflement.

exercises.prompt: Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.answer: 難 道
exercises.explanation: 難道 (nán dào) — "don't tell me that…". Don't confuse with 難怪 (no wonder), 難看 (ugly), or 難受 (uncomfortable). Listen for the 4th-tone 道.

lessons.title: Concede then push back
lessons.description: 雖然…但是 — yes, but…

exercises.prompt: What does "雖然…但是" (suī rán…dàn shì) mean?
exercises.answer: Although… but / however

exercises.prompt: Build "Although what you said makes sense, I still disagree"
exercises.answer: 雖然 你 說 得 有 道理 但是 我 還是 不 同意

exercises.prompt: "我承認你說得有道理" means ___
exercises.answer: I admit what you said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I'll grant that you have a point
I admit you have a point

exercises.prompt: the concession opener to its tone
Build "Although your view has its merits, the situation is more complex than you think"
exercises.answer: 雖然 你 的 看法 有 道理 但是 情況 比 你 想 得 複雜

exercises.prompt: "不可否認" (bù kě fǒu rèn) means ___
exercises.answer: Undeniably / it cannot be denied
exercises.explanation: 不可否認 — formal essay opener that concedes a fact before offering a counter-argument. "Undeniably X is true, however…"

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "You make a fair point, but I still disagree":
options: 你說得有道理，不過我還是不同意
exercises.answer: 你說得有道理，不過我還是不同意
exercises.explanation: 不過 ("however") + 還是 ("still") is the staple concession-then-pushback structure.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal pushback: "Although what you said is reasonable, we cannot ignore another important factor"
exercises.answer: 儘管 你 說 的 有 道理 但是 我們 不 能 忽視 另 一 個 重要 的 因素

exercises.prompt: "你這麼說也對，但是…" means ___
exercises.answer: What you say is also right, but…
acceptableAnswers: There's truth to what you're saying, but

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay-style concession (not casual):
options: 誠然，A的觀點有其合理性，然而…
exercises.answer: 誠然，A的觀點有其合理性，然而…
exercises.explanation: 誠然 ("to be sure") + 有其合理性 ("has its rationality") + 然而 ("however") — full essay register.

exercises.prompt: Build a layered pushback: "On one hand I admit your point; on the other I think there are problems"
exercises.answer: 一 方面 我 承認 你 的 觀點 另 一 方面 我 認為 也 有 問題

exercises.prompt: Tap the concession word you hear
exercises.answer: 確 實
exercises.explanation: 確實 (què shí) — "indeed/truly" — the strong-agreement concession word. Distinguish from 其實 (actually), 事實 (fact), 真實 (real).

lessons.title: Reasons & evidence
lessons.description: 因為…所以 and 由於

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between 因為 and 由於?
options: 因為 is more conversational; 由於 is more formal/written
因為 is positive; 由於 is negative
exercises.answer: 因為 is more conversational; 由於 is more formal/written

exercises.prompt: Build "Because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled"
exercises.answer: 因為 天氣 不 好 所以 航班 取消 了

exercises.prompt: "主要原因是…" (zhǔ yào yuán yīn shì) means ___
exercises.answer: The main reason is

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "There are many reasons for this":
exercises.answer: 這有很多原因

exercises.prompt: the cause-effect connector to its register

pairs.right: Stylized: the reason X is because Y

exercises.prompt: Build a stylized cause-effect: "The reason I came is because I want to help you" (之所以...是因為)
exercises.answer: 我 之所以 來 是 因為 我 想 幫 你
exercises.explanation: 之所以 X 是因為 Y — flips the order to highlight the cause: "the reason for X is Y". A B2 favorite for emphasis.

exercises.prompt: "由此可見" (yóu cǐ kě jiàn) means ___
exercises.answer: From this we can see / from this it is evident
exercises.explanation: Essay-register transition phrase before drawing a conclusion.

exercises.prompt: Pick the FORMAL written version of "because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled":
options: 由於天氣惡劣，航班被迫取消
因為天氣不好，航班取消了
exercises.answer: 由於天氣惡劣，航班被迫取消
exercises.explanation: 由於 + 惡劣 (severe, formal) + 被迫 (forced) is news/written register. The casual version uses 因為 + 不好 + 了.

exercises.prompt: Build "Due to limited time, we'll have to discuss this next time"
exercises.answer: 由於 時間 有限 我們 下次 再 討論

exercises.prompt: "原因有以下幾點" (yuán yīn yǒu yǐ xià jǐ diǎn) means ___
exercises.answer: The reasons are as follows
acceptableAnswers: There are several reasons listed below
The reasons include the following points
exercises.explanation: 以下幾點 — "the following several points" — essay structuring phrase before listing reasons.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This not only affects me but also affects my family" (不僅...還):
options: 這不僅影響我，還影響我的家人
exercises.answer: 這不僅影響我，還影響我的家人

exercises.prompt: Tap the cause connector you hear
exercises.answer: 因 此
exercises.explanation: 因此 (yīn cǐ, therefore) is paired with 由於 / 因為 to mark the consequence half. Don't confuse with 因為 (because) or 由此 (from this).

lessons.title: Closing your argument
lessons.description: 總之, 總的來說 — summing up

exercises.prompt: the closing phrase
Build "In short, I think we should support this plan"
exercises.answer: 總之 我 覺得 我們 應該 支援 這個 計劃

exercises.prompt: "總的來說，他是個好人" means ___
exercises.answer: Generally speaking, he's a good person
acceptableAnswers: All in all, he's a good person
Overall, he is a good person

exercises.prompt: the closing/transition phrase to its register

pairs.right: Formal essay: in summary of the above
Stylized: in a word / all things considered
Fundamentally / at the root of it

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay-style summary opener:
exercises.answer: 綜上所述，
exercises.explanation: 綜上所述 — "in summary of all the above" — the standard closing transition for a written argument.

exercises.prompt: Build "In short, we should think about this issue from multiple angles"
exercises.answer: 總之 我們 應該 從 多 個 角度 思考 這 個 問題

exercises.prompt: "歸根結底" (guī gēn jié dǐ) means ___
exercises.answer: Fundamentally / at the root of it / when all is said and done
acceptableAnswers: When you trace it to the root
exercises.explanation: Chengyu used to introduce a final fundamental cause: 歸根結底，問題在於… ("fundamentally, the issue is…").

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "In other words, we need to act":
options: 換句話說，我們需要行動
exercises.answer: 換句話說，我們需要行動

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this plan has more advantages than disadvantages"
exercises.answer: 總 的 來 說 這 個 方案 的 優 點 多 於 缺 點
exercises.explanation: 多於 (more than) is the formal compare-pattern for written essays. Casual would be: 優點比缺點多.

exercises.prompt: "由此可見，環保勢在必行" means ___
exercises.answer: From this it is clear that environmental protection is imperative
acceptableAnswers: From this we can see that environmental protection must happen
exercises.explanation: 勢在必行 (shì zài bì xíng) — "the situation requires it must be done" — strong-action chengyu.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most casual conversation closer:
options: 綜上所述，本人持上述觀點
總而言之，鄙人深以為然
exercises.answer: 總之就這樣
exercises.explanation: 總之就這樣 — "anyway, that's how it is" — casual chat closer. The other options are formal/literary.

exercises.prompt: Tap the closing-phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 總 而 言 之
options: 總 而 言 之
總 的 來 說
綜 上 所 述
exercises.answer: 總 而 言 之
exercises.explanation: 總而言之 (zǒng ér yán zhī) — four-syllable formal summary phrase. Listen for the rhythm; the others differ in syllable count or register.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Polite disagreement on a panel
lessons.description: Open with concession, push back, and propose a hedged middle path

exercises.prompt: On a panel about the future of remote work

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 我認為遠端辦公已經徹底取代了傳統辦公室。(Wǒ rènwéi yuǎnchéng bàngōng yǐjīng chèdǐ qǔdài le chuántǒng bàngōngshì.)
turns.spokenText: 我認為遠端辦公已經徹底取代了傳統辦公室。

turns.speaker: you
options: 您的觀點很有意思，不過我有一點不同看法。(Nín de guāndiǎn hěn yǒuyìsi, búguò wǒ yǒu yīdiǎn bùtóng kànfǎ.)

觀點不需要因為不同看法。(Guāndiǎn bù xūyào yīnwèi bùtóng kànfǎ.)
turns.answer: 您的觀點很有意思，不過我有一點不同看法。(Nín de guāndiǎn hěn yǒuyìsi, búguò wǒ yǒu yīdiǎn bùtóng kànfǎ.)

turns.speaker: panelist

turns.answer: 遠端辦公確實有優勢，但是面對面交流難以完全替代。(Yuǎnchéng bàngōng quèshí yǒu yōushì, dànshì miànduìmiàn jiāoliú nányǐ wánquán tìdài.)

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 您說的有一定道理，那您建議怎麼平衡？(Nín shuō de yǒu yīdìng dàolǐ, nà nín jiànyì zěnme pínghéng?)
turns.spokenText: 您說的有一定道理，那您建議怎麼平衡？

turns.after: 混合辦公會是比較合理的方向。(___ hùnhé bàngōng huì shì bǐjiào hélǐ de fāngxiàng.)

turns.text: 混合模式確實越來越主流了。(Hùnhé móshì quèshí yuèláiyuè zhǔliú le.)

弱化不需要因為文化擔心。(Ruòhuà bù xūyào yīnwèi wénhuà dānxīn.)
turns.answer: 我並不是反對遠端，只是擔心團隊文化被弱化。(Wǒ bìng bù shì fǎnduì yuǎnchéng, zhǐshì dānxīn tuánduì wénhuà bèi ruòhuà.)

topics.title: Formal communication
topics.description: Emails, speeches, signs — when 你 becomes 您

guide.intro: Mandarin makes a sharp distinction between casual and formal register. The same idea — "Could you please send me the document?" — sounds completely different in a WeChat to a friend versus an email to a client. B2 is where you start being able to switch.

sections.text: Pronouns and politeness

您 (nín) is the polite "you". You'll use it for clients, customers, elders, professors, and strangers in any service context. In groups, 您們 is rare — most speakers stay with 您 (singular) or use 各位 (everyone).
Word swaps that lift the register
Email openers and closers

rows.pinyin: Zūn jìng de Wáng lǎo shī:
rows.translation: Dear (respected) Teacher Wang,

rows.pinyin: Nín hǎo!
rows.translation: Hello (formal).

rows.pinyin: Gǎn xiè nín de zhī chí.
rows.translation: Thank you for your support.

rows.pinyin: Shùn zhù shāng qí.
rows.translation: Wishing you well in business. (formal sign-off)

sections.text: Casual Chinese loves 啊, 呢, 啦 — the little sentence-final particles that soften tone. Formal Chinese strips them all out. If you find yourself writing 你好啊 to a client, switch back to 您好.
Quick guide: discourse particles
Particles carry no dictionary meaning but huge emotional color. Use them in casual speech; strip them in formal writing.

items: 哎 (āi) — getting attention or expressing mild dismay: 哎，你来一下 (Hey, come here a sec)
哎呀 (āi yā) — "oh!" / "oops!" — surprise or annoyance: 哎呀，又下雨了 (Ugh, it's raining again)
啊 (a) — softens a statement or question: 你好啊 (Hi there) / 真的啊？ (Really?)
呢 (ne) — "and you?" / continuing-state marker: 你呢？ (And you?) / 他在睡觉呢 (He's sleeping [right now])
嘛 (ma) — "obviously" / "as you know": 这是常识嘛 (That's just common sense, isn't it)
