lessons.title: Casual vs formal
lessons.description: When to switch from 你 to 您

exercises.prompt: Which is more polite: 你 or 您?
exercises.answer: 您

exercises.prompt: casual to formal
Which sentence sounds appropriate in a business email?
options: 尊敬的張先生，請問您何時方便回覆郵件？
exercises.answer: 尊敬的張先生，請問您何時方便回覆郵件？
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的, 您, 何時方便 — every choice signals formality. Note the word order: 何時方便 (when [are you] free), not 方便何時.

exercises.prompt: casual to formal pronoun/word
Build a formal request: "May I please ask, when are you available"
exercises.answer: 請 問 您 何 時 方 便

exercises.prompt: Your boss WeChats you about a deadline. Pick the appropriate reply:
exercises.answer: 好的，我會按時完成。
exercises.explanation: 好的 + complete sentence + 按時完成 ("finish on time") strikes the right professional-but-warm register. The others are too breezy for a workplace context.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "現在很多人都在家工作" to formal register: "___ 許多 人 都 在 家 辦公"
exercises.answer: 目前
exercises.explanation: 現在 → 目前 is the standard register lift. 許多 (instead of 很多) and 辦公 (instead of 工作) also lift the register.

exercises.prompt: the casual phrase to its formal/written equivalent
Build a formal sentence: "Currently the company is facing many challenges"
exercises.answer: 目前 公司 面臨 許多 挑戰

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is CASUAL?
exercises.answer: 哎，那事兒你聽說了嗎
exercises.explanation: 哎 (sentence-initial particle), 那事兒 (érhuà), 你 — every choice is informal. The others are essay/email register.

exercises.prompt: "久仰大名" (jiǔ yǎng dà míng) is used when ___
exercises.answer: Meeting someone formally for the first time — "I've long admired your name"
acceptableAnswers: Greeting someone whose reputation precedes them
Formally meeting a respected person for the first time
exercises.explanation: 久仰大名 — fixed formal greeting reserved for first introductions to someone with high standing. Don't use casually.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal pronoun you hear
exercises.answer: 您
exercises.explanation: 您 (nín) and 你 (nǐ) sound nearly identical in fast speech, but 您 is reserved for politeness. Listen carefully — the nasal ending on 您 is slightly held.

lessons.title: Writing an email
lessons.description: Opener, body, sign-off

exercises.prompt: What is "尊敬的" (zūn jìng de) used for?
options: A respectful salutation in formal letters/emails
exercises.answer: A respectful salutation in formal letters/emails

exercises.prompt: Build "Could you please send me the document by tomorrow?"
exercises.answer: 麻煩 您 明天 之前 把 檔案 發給 我

exercises.prompt: "感謝您的支援" means ___
exercises.answer: Thank you for your support
acceptableAnswers: We thank you for your support

exercises.prompt: Which is a formal sign-off?
exercises.answer: 此致敬禮。
exercises.explanation: 此致敬禮 — a fixed phrase ending formal letters, no real English equivalent. "Yours sincerely" is closest.

exercises.prompt: the formal sign-off to its use
When would you write 順祝商祺 vs 此致敬禮?
options: 順祝商祺 = business letters; 此致敬禮 = universal formal letters
順祝商祺 = casual; 此致敬禮 = formal
exercises.answer: 順祝商祺 = business letters; 此致敬禮 = universal formal letters
exercises.explanation: 順祝商祺 specifically wishes business prosperity — use it in B2B emails. 此致敬禮 is the safe default for any formal letter.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal email opener: "Dear (respected) Mr. Wang, hello"
exercises.answer: 尊敬 的 王 先生 您 好

exercises.prompt: "敬請回復" (jìng qǐng huí fù) means ___
exercises.answer: Please respond (formal request for reply)

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is a CORRECT formal request body?
options: 麻煩您把檔案發一下，謝謝。
急需您的批准，請儘快回覆。
Both A and B are appropriate
exercises.answer: Both A and B are appropriate
exercises.explanation: Both 麻煩您 + 謝謝 (warm-formal) and 急需 + 請儘快 (urgent-formal) work as email body lines. Different registers for different relationships.

exercises.prompt: Build the email body: "I am writing to inquire about the recent project progress"
exercises.answer: 本人 寫 此 郵件 是 想 瞭解 最近 專案 的 進展

exercises.prompt: "如蒙回覆，不勝感激" (rú méng huí fù, bù shèng gǎn jī) means ___
exercises.answer: If you would reply, I'd be deeply grateful
acceptableAnswers: I'd be most grateful for your reply
Should you reply, I'll be very grateful
exercises.explanation: 如蒙 (if granted) + 不勝感激 (overwhelmingly grateful) — pure formal-letter register. Common in academic and business correspondence.

exercises.prompt: Tap the email opener you hear
exercises.answer: 尊 敬 的
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 (zūn jìng de) — "Respected" — is the standard salutation prefix. 尊重 means "respect" the verb, not for greetings.

lessons.title: Polite requests
lessons.description: 請, 麻煩您, 能否

exercises.prompt: the polite phrase
Build "May I ask, what time does the meeting start?"
exercises.answer: 請問 會議 幾 點 開始

exercises.prompt: "能否請您介紹一下？" means ___
exercises.answer: Could you please introduce yourself?
acceptableAnswers: Could you give a brief introduction?
Could I ask you to introduce yourself?

exercises.prompt: the polite request to its use
Build a formal request: "Please wait a moment, I will check immediately"
exercises.answer: 請 您 稍 等 我 馬 上 查 一 下

exercises.prompt: A customer service rep would say:
exercises.answer: 請您稍候
exercises.explanation: 請您稍候 — "please wait a moment" — the standard service-industry phrase. 候 (hòu) is more formal than 等.

exercises.prompt: "如有疑問，請聯絡我們" means ___
exercises.answer: If you have any questions, please contact us
acceptableAnswers: Should you have questions, please reach out
If you have inquiries, please contact us
exercises.explanation: 如有 (if there are) — formal conditional. 疑問 = inquiry / question — more formal than 問題.

exercises.prompt: Pick the appropriate request to a teacher (not a friend):
exercises.answer: 老師，能不能給我看看？
exercises.explanation: Address the teacher (老師), use 能不能 (could you), soften with 看看 (have a look). The other options are too direct or grammatically incomplete for the context.

exercises.prompt: Build a polite phone request: "May I trouble you to transfer my call to manager Li?"
exercises.answer: 麻煩 您 幫 我 轉接 給 李 經理

exercises.prompt: "望您理解" (wàng nín lǐ jiě) means ___
exercises.answer: Hope for your understanding
exercises.explanation: 望 = hope (formal/written equivalent of 希望). Common in formal apologies and explanations.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Sorry to trouble you, could you help me check this?":
options: 麻煩您了，能幫我查一下嗎？
exercises.answer: 麻煩您了，能幫我查一下嗎？
exercises.explanation: 麻煩您了 — "sorry to trouble you" — apology+request frame. 幫我 + V + 一下 softens the ask further.

exercises.prompt: Tap the polite verb you hear
exercises.answer: 麻 煩
exercises.explanation: 麻煩 (má fan) — "to trouble (someone)" — the politeness keyword. 2nd tone + neutral. Don't confuse with 麻木 (numb).

lessons.title: Speeches & openings
lessons.description: Standing in front of a room

exercises.prompt: How would a speaker typically open in front of a group?
options: 各位領導，各位來賓，大家好
exercises.answer: 各位領導，各位來賓，大家好
exercises.explanation: 各位 + role is the standard. 各位領導 = honored leaders, 各位來賓 = honored guests.

exercises.prompt: Build "First of all, thank you all for coming"
exercises.answer: 首先 感謝 大家 的 到來

exercises.prompt: "今天我想跟大家分享…" means ___
exercises.answer: Today I want to share with everyone…
acceptableAnswers: Today I'd like to share with all of you...
Today I want to share with you all

exercises.prompt: the speech-opening element to its function
Pick the appropriate speech CLOSING:
options: 謝謝大家，我的發言到此結束
exercises.answer: 謝謝大家，我的發言到此結束
exercises.explanation: Standard speech ending: thank the audience, then close with 到此結束 ("ends here"). The casual options would never appear in a formal speech.

exercises.prompt: Build a speech transition: "Next, please allow me to introduce…"
exercises.answer: 接 下 來 請 允 許 我 介紹

exercises.prompt: "在此，我謹代表…" means ___
exercises.answer: Here / on this occasion, I respectfully represent…
acceptableAnswers: On this occasion, on behalf of…
exercises.explanation: 在此 (here/on this occasion) + 謹 (respectfully) + 代表 (represent) — the standard speech opener for representing an organization.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "On behalf of the company, I extend a warm welcome to all guests":
options: 我代表公司熱烈歡迎各位來賓
exercises.answer: 我代表公司熱烈歡迎各位來賓

exercises.prompt: Build "I'd like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their support"
exercises.answer: 我 想 借 此 機 會 感 謝 大 家 的 支 持
exercises.explanation: 藉此機會 — "taking this opportunity" — set phrase for transitioning into thanks during a speech.

exercises.prompt: "恭喜恭喜" (gōng xǐ gōng xǐ) is used when ___
exercises.answer: Offering congratulations
exercises.explanation: Reduplication 恭喜恭喜 doubles the warmth. Used when meeting someone after good news (promotion, marriage, baby).

exercises.prompt: Pick the appropriate INTRODUCTION at a wedding banquet (the bride's father speaking):
options: 尊敬的各位來賓，感謝大家在百忙之中前來參加
exercises.answer: 尊敬的各位來賓，感謝大家在百忙之中前來參加
exercises.explanation: 百忙之中 ("in the midst of busy schedules") — fixed phrase acknowledging guests' time. 前來 (formal "come here to") completes the formal register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the speech opener you hear
exercises.answer: 首 先
exercises.explanation: 首先 (shǒu xiān) — "first". Speech sequencing trio: 首先, 其次, 最後.

topics.title: B2 review
topics.description: Stitch the patterns together: 越…越, 不僅…而且, 即使…也, 儘管, formal register

lessons.title: Pattern roundup
lessons.description: Pick the right connector

exercises.prompt: the pattern to its meaning
Pick the right connector for a real fact: "___ 下雨，他還是去跑步了"
exercises.answer: 儘管
exercises.explanation: It's a real fact (it actually rained), so 儘管 / 雖然. 即使 would be hypothetical.

exercises.prompt: Pick the right connector: "___ 下雨，我也要去" (you don't yet know if it'll rain)
exercises.answer: 即使

exercises.prompt: Pick the right connector: "他 ___ 努力工作，___ 收入很高"
exercises.answer: 不僅 / 而且
exercises.explanation: Adding two positive qualities → 不僅...而且. The other connectors don't fit "works hard AND earns well" as a parallel additive pair.

exercises.prompt: Build the connector sentence "He not only is smart, he also is hardworking" (use 不僅...而且)
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 聰明 而且 努力
exercises.explanation: 不僅 must pair with an additive (而且 / 還 / 也). It cannot pair with the contrastive 但是 — they push in opposite directions.

exercises.prompt: the connector to its required partner
"環保 ___ 來 ___ 重要" (越…越 pattern)
exercises.answer: 越 / 越
exercises.explanation: 環保越來越重要 — "environmental protection is more and more important". Both halves of the 越 frame are required.

exercises.prompt: Which is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 他越來越很努力
exercises.explanation: 越來越 already intensifies. Adding 很 doubles up. Drop one or the other.

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand, the salary is high; on the other hand, the pressure is also great"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工資 很 高 另一方面 壓力 也 很 大

exercises.prompt: "___ 人工智慧 發展 得 很 快, ___ 不 能 完全 取代 人類"
exercises.answer: 儘管 / 但是
exercises.explanation: Real fact (AI develops fast) + contrast (can't replace humans) → 儘管/雖然...但是 frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the layered scenario translation: "Even if you disagree, in my view this is still the right thing to do":
options: 即使你不同意，在我看來這也是正確的事
exercises.answer: 即使你不同意，在我看來這也是正確的事
exercises.explanation: Multi-clause B2: 即使...也 (even if...still) + 在我看來 (in my view) — combining concession with opinion-stating in one breath.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector pair you hear
exercises.spokenText: 不 僅 而 且
options: 不 僅 而 且
盡 管 但 是
雖 然 但 是
exercises.answer: 不 僅 而 且
exercises.explanation: 不僅...而且 — the additive pair. Identifying which connector pair you hear is the first step to parsing complex sentences quickly.

lessons.title: Long-sentence build
lessons.description: Compound sentences from scratch

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the work is tiring, the salary is fairly good"
exercises.answer: 雖然 工作 很 累 但是 工資 比較 不錯

exercises.prompt: Build "He not only studies hard but also works very hard"
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 學習 努力 而且 工作 也 非常 努力

exercises.prompt: Build "The longer I live in China, the more I like the food here"
exercises.answer: 我 在 中國 住 得 越 久 就 越 喜歡 這裡 的 食物

exercises.prompt: the connector pair to the function it expresses in a sentence

pairs.right: Hold a position despite a hypothetical
Concede a real fact, then contrast

exercises.prompt: Build "Although AI is convenient, it not only changes our jobs but also raises ethical issues" (儘管...但是 + 不僅...而且)
exercises.answer: 儘管 AI 很 方便 但是 它 不僅 改變 我們 的 工作 而且 引發 倫理 問題

exercises.prompt: Tap the compound sentence you hear
exercises.spokenText: 一 方 面 網 課 很 方 便 另 一 方 面 缺 少 互 動
options: 一 方 面 網 課 很 方 便 另 一 方 面 缺 少 互 動
網 課 很 方 便 但 是 缺 少 互 動
一 方 面 網 課 不 方 便 另 一 方 面 互 動 多
網 課 互 動 不 多 但 是 方 便
exercises.answer: 一 方 面 網 課 很 方 便 另 一 方 面 缺 少 互 動
exercises.explanation: 一方面...另一方面 has a distinctive cadence — two parallel four-syllable openers framing the two sides.

exercises.prompt: Convert single-clause to compound: "This phone is expensive AND has poor battery life". Use 不僅...而且: "這 部 手機 ___ 貴 ___ 電池 也 不 好"
exercises.answer: 不僅 / 而且

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "The more you study, the more you'll find there's still much you don't know":
options: 你越學越發現還有很多不知道的
exercises.answer: 你越學越發現還有很多不知道的
exercises.explanation: 越...越 with two related clauses; 還有很多不知道的 = "there's still much I don't know".

exercises.prompt: the long compound sentence to the rhetorical move it performs

pairs.right: Concede a real fact, then contrast
Stack a second, often stronger, point

exercises.prompt: Fill the connectors: "___ 她 年紀 小 ___ 她 不僅 有 經驗 ___ 有 智慧" (although...but...not only...also)
exercises.answer: 雖然 / 但是 / 而且
acceptableAnswers: 雖然 但是 而且
儘管 / 但是 / 而且
exercises.explanation: 雖然 needs 但是. 不僅 needs 而且 / 還 / 也. Two connector pairs in one layered sentence.

exercises.prompt: "越來越多的人開始關注環保" means ___
exercises.answer: More and more people are starting to pay attention to environmental protection
acceptableAnswers: An increasing number of people are paying attention to environmentalism
More people are getting concerned about the environment

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct B2 compound sentence:
options: 儘管 996 很辛苦，但是很多年輕人不僅不抗議，而且選擇躺平
儘管 996 很辛苦，因為很多年輕人選擇躺平
儘管 996 但是不僅躺平
exercises.answer: 儘管 996 很辛苦，但是很多年輕人不僅不抗議，而且選擇躺平
exercises.explanation: Layered B2: 儘管...但是 (concession) followed by 不僅不...而且 (negative not-only-but-also) — both connector pairs correctly partnered.

lessons.title: Register switch
lessons.description: Casual or formal?

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is FORMAL?
options: 尊敬的李總，請問您何時方便？
exercises.answer: 尊敬的李總，請問您何時方便？

exercises.prompt: casual to formal again
Which is the right closing for a business email?
exercises.answer: 此致敬禮。

exercises.prompt: Your boss WeChats you about a deadline. Pick the appropriate reply:
exercises.answer: 好的，我會按時完成。
exercises.explanation: Workplace casual-formal: 好的 + complete sentence. The other options are too casual for boss communication.

exercises.prompt: Your friend WeChats you the same question. Pick the appropriate reply:
options: 敬請放心，必將按期完成
我謹代表自己保證完成
exercises.answer: 好嘞，沒問題
exercises.explanation: Friend = casual register: 好嘞, 沒問題. The formal options would be jarringly stiff between friends.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual to formal: "現在 沒什麼時間，因為 太忙了" → formal version
exercises.answer: 目前 沒 有 太 多 時間 由於 工作 繁忙
exercises.explanation: 現在→目前, 因為→由於, 太忙了→工作繁忙. Each swap raises the register a level.

exercises.prompt: casual to formal sentence-pair
Casual: 你好啊！ → Formal email opener: ___
exercises.answer: 您好
exercises.explanation: Strip the 啊 particle and swap 你 → 您. The exclamation is optional in formal writing.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual 都怪我，我來背鍋 to a formal version. The blank fills: "___ 願意 為此 承擔 全部 責任"
exercises.answer: 本人
exercises.explanation: 本人 (formal first-person) replaces casual 我 / 哥 / 我自己. 承擔 (assume) replaces 背鍋 (slang "take the blame"). 全部責任 = full responsibility.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal opening: "I am writing to thank you for your help"
exercises.answer: 我 寫 此 信 是 想 感 謝 您 的 幫助

exercises.prompt: "敬請回復" is closer in register to: ___
exercises.answer: Please respond (formal)
exercises.explanation: 敬 (respectfully) + 請 (please) + 回覆 (reply) — formal email request. Casual equivalent: 給我回個話唄 / 幫我回一下.

exercises.prompt: Tap the FORMAL connector you hear
exercises.answer: 然 而
exercises.explanation: 然而 — formal/written "however". 但是 / 可是 / 不過 are progressively more casual. Anchor delivery and essay reading favor 然而.

lessons.title: B2 mixed challenge
lessons.description: All the patterns at once

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if the pressure is great, I'll still keep going"
exercises.answer: 即使 壓力 很 大 我 也 會 堅持 下去

exercises.prompt: Build "In short, environmental protection is getting more and more important"
exercises.answer: 總之 環保 越 來 越 重要

exercises.prompt: Pick the most natural translation of "I have to admit, what you said makes a lot of sense":
options: 我得承認，你說得很有道理
exercises.answer: 我得承認，你說得很有道理
exercises.explanation: 得 (děi) here = must / have to. 我得承認 is a great softener before conceding a point in an argument.

exercises.prompt: "我對這個話題非常感興趣" means ___
exercises.answer: I am very interested in this topic
acceptableAnswers: I'm really interested in this topic
This topic interests me a lot

exercises.prompt: Build the layered B2 sentence: "Although the work is tough, I not only finished it but also learned a lot"
exercises.answer: 雖然 工作 很 難 但是 我 不僅 完成 了 而且 學 到 了 很 多

exercises.prompt: Tap the trend statement you hear
exercises.spokenText: 越 來 越 多 的 年 輕 人 選 擇 躺 平
options: 越 來 越 多 的 年 輕 人 選 擇 躺 平
越 來 越 多 的 年 輕 人 選 擇 內 卷
越 來 越 少 年 輕 人 選 擇 躺 平
年 輕 人 越 來 越 不 喜 歡 躺 平
exercises.answer: 越 來 越 多 的 年 輕 人 選 擇 躺 平
exercises.explanation: Trend reporting: 越來越多的 + N + 選擇 + V — the standard frame in news essays. Listen for the verb at the end (躺平 vs 內卷).

exercises.prompt: Pick the most natural translation: "In short, environmental protection isn't just the government's job; it's everyone's responsibility":
options: 總之，環保不僅是政府的事，更是每個人的責任
exercises.answer: 總之，環保不僅是政府的事，更是每個人的責任
exercises.explanation: Layered: 總之 (summarizing) + 不僅...更 (intensified additive). 更 amplifies beyond 而且.

exercises.prompt: Convert formal: "由於工作繁忙，本人尚未完成。" To casual chat with a friend: ___
exercises.answer: 因為太忙了，我還沒做完
acceptableAnswers: 因為太忙了我還沒做完
exercises.explanation: Casual swaps: 由於→因為, 工作繁忙→太忙了, 本人→我, 尚未→還沒.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence pairs the connectors CORRECTLY?
options: 他不僅聰明，但是很努力
雖然他很累，但是沒有放棄
exercises.answer: 雖然他很累，但是沒有放棄
exercises.explanation: 雖然 needs 但是. 不僅 needs 而且/還/也. 儘管 pairs with 但是/還是, not 也. 即使 pairs with 也/還, not 但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my view, even if AI develops fast, we still cannot ignore ethics" (在我看來 + 即使...也)
exercises.answer: 在 我 看 來 即使 人工智慧 發展 得 很 快 我們 也 不 能 忽視 倫理

exercises.prompt: "凡事都有兩面，關鍵在於我們怎麼看" means ___
exercises.answer: Everything has two sides; the key is how we look at it
acceptableAnswers: Every issue has two sides — the key is our perspective
There are two sides to everything; what matters is how we view it
exercises.explanation: 凡事都有兩面 + 關鍵在於 — combined B2 essay frame for opening a balanced opinion piece.

exercises.prompt: the B2 connector frame to a sample English meaning

pairs.right: The more X, the more Y
Not only X, but also Y
The reason for X is because Y

lessons.title: Dialogue: A workplace incident — opinion and register
lessons.description: Give a hedged opinion, report hearsay, and propose a formal fix

exercises.prompt: Coworker debriefs after a colleague clashed with a client in a meeting

turns.speaker: li
turns.text: 今天會議上小王跟客戶嗆聲了，你怎麼看？(Jīntiān huìyì shàng Xiǎo Wáng gēn kèhù qiāngshēng le, nǐ zěnme kàn?)
turns.spokenText: 今天會議上小王跟客戶嗆聲了，你怎麼看？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Give a hedged opinion with concession.
options: 雖然他出發點是好的，但是說話方式確實欠妥。(Suīrán tā chūfādiǎn shì hǎo de, dànshì shuōhuà fāngshì quèshí qiàn tuǒ.)
他完全錯了應該立刻被開除掉。(Tā wánquán cuò le yīnggāi lìkè bèi kāichú diào.)
出發點不需要因為方式欠妥。(Chūfādiǎn bù xūyào yīnwèi fāngshì qiàn tuǒ.)
